articles.title: AIG Dropped Sharply in January. The Stock Is a Buy.
articles.mainIdea: AIG Dropped Sharply in January. The Stock Is a Buy.
articles.summary: Barrons.com: AIG Dropped Sharply in January. The Stock Is a Buy.. American International Group has completed a major turnaround since the property-and-casualty insurer nearly collapsed during the 2008-09 financial crisis. The insurer’s shares dropped 7% in early January on surprise news that CEO Peter Zaffino would step down on June 1 while remaining chairman. AIG said Zaffino’s decision was his own and that its board “remains very confident in Peter’s leadership and integrity.” Related tickers mentioned: AIG, AON, CRBG, TRV, WSFX.BO.
